question: The Finance Commission of India is set up under ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 280.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Finance Commissions are commissions periodically constituted by the President of India under Article 280 of the Indian Constitution to define the financial relations between the central government of India and the individual state governments.

 
 
• Its core responsibility is to:

 
 
• Evaluate the state of finances of the Union and State Governments
 
• Recommend the sharing of taxes between them
 
• Lay down the principles determining the distribution of these taxes among States.
 
 
 
 
 
• The Finance Commission is required to make recommendations to the President of India.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **sale or purchase of water or electricity is not subject to state taxes under Article 288** of the Indian Constitution, unless the President of India grants permission through legislation.
 
• The Indian Constitution's **Article 265 addresses taxes that cannot be levied absent legal permission**.
 
 
• It indicates that no tax may be imposed or gathered unless authorized by law.
 
 
 
• The Indian Constitution's **Article 277 addresses the Union and State governments' taxing authority.**
